failures.pattern: [38;2;74;222;128m[1m✓[0m reveal shows 1/3 pass count on failure
failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test and sw-intent-analysis-test exited 1, likely due to missing/invalid API credentials or environment setup rather than a code regression
failures.fix: Check test logs for these two suites for auth/env errors and gate them on required secrets or fix the underlying assertion

failures.root_cause: Pipeline stage tests expect artifacts (plan.md, review.md) and non-zero exit paths that the mocked build/plan/review stages never write, and one intelligence test's jq call receives non-numeric complexity output
failures.fix: Fix mock stage scripts to write plan.md/review.md artifacts before stage completion and sanitize the complexity value passed to jq in the low-complexity intelligence test

failures.pattern: [2m  loop behavior: iterations on test failure[0m
failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test hung past the 300s suite timeout and sw-intent-analysis-test failed with a real assertion error (exit 1)
failures.fix: investigate and fix the sw-intent-analysis-test assertion failure, and add an internal timeout/mock guard to sw-e2e-integration-test so it fails fast instead of hanging to the global timeout

failures.root_cause: One of the 80 shipwright test suites failed an assertion during scripts/sw-test-all.sh execution, but the failing suite name/output is truncated before the 200-line log window
failures.fix: Re-run scripts/sw-test-all.sh with verbose output and grep for the FAIL marker to identify the specific suite and assertion, then patch the failing script or its test expectations

failures.root_cause: sw-pipeline-test.sh mock artifacts drift: plan/review stage mocks no longer write plan.md/review.md (or a shared setup helper regressed), cascading to E2E, resume, and cleanup tests that depend on those files existing
failures.fix: Fix the plan/review stage mocks in sw-pipeline-test.sh to write plan.md and review.md as expected, then rerun the dependent E2E/resume/cleanup/intelligence-complexity subtests
